predictions.selection_reason: creates cookies with path=/ -> stores authentication tokens, passwords, settings -> if mishandled could lead to session fixation or sensitive data exposure
predictions.source_summary: Function parameters (name, value, days) passed by callers; used to store application settings including potentially sensitive data like passwords
predictions.sink_summary: document.cookie with path=/ but missing HttpOnly and Secure flags
predictions.guard_summary: No validation of cookie names/values; no HttpOnly flag to prevent XSS access; no Secure flag for HTTPS-only transmission; path=/ makes cookies accessible across entire domain
predictions.risk_pattern: Creates cookies without security attributes (HttpOnly, Secure), storing sensitive application settings including passwords in plaintext cookies accessible via JavaScript
predictions.context_summary: Cookie creation function derived from QuirksMode.org, used to store VNC client settings including 'password', 'host', 'port' without security attributes
unresolved_facts: Whether cookies are used over HTTPS in production
Whether password values are encrypted before storage
Specific sensitivity level of stored password values
